definitions.explanation: A chemical compound made up only of carbon and hydrogen atoms. Hydrocarbons are the main components of petroleum and natural gas.

examples.japanese: {炭化水素|たんかすいそ}を{含|ふく}む。
{石油|せきゆ}は{炭化水素|たんかすいそ}の{混合物|こんごうぶつ}である。
examples.english: Petroleum is a mixture of hydrocarbons.

examples.japanese: {炭化水素|たんかすいそ}を{燃|も}やすと、{二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}と{水|みず}ができる。
examples.english: When hydrocarbons burn, carbon dioxide and water are produced.

notes:
Combines {炭素|たんそ} (carbon) and {水素|すいそ} (hydrogen). Hydrocarbons are the basic building blocks of fuels such as petroleum and natural gas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭化水素|たんかすいそ}の{燃焼|ねんしょう}: combustion of hydrocarbons
- {芳香族|ほうこうぞく}{炭化水素|たんかすいそ}: aromatic hydrocarbons
- {飽和|ほうわ}{炭化水素|たんかすいそ}: saturated hydrocarbons
